ChatGPT said:

You’ve got two separate issues here—and both come from small but important logic mistakes.

🔴 Problem 1: Both sides’ pawns are white

The issue is in this function:

JavaScript
const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
  const unicode = {
    K: "♔", Q: "♕", R: "♖", B: "♗", N: "♘", P: "♙",
    k: "♚", q: "♛", r: "♜", b: "♝", n: "♞", p: "♟",
  };
  return unicode[piece.type] || "";
};

👉 chess.js does NOT return uppercase/lowercase types
Instead:

  • piece.type is always lowercase (p, r, etc.)

  • piece.color is "w" or "b"

So you're always mapping to white pieces (P → ♙) ❌

✅ Fix it like this:

JavaScript
const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
  const unicode = {
    wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
    bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
  };

  return unicode[piece.color + piece.type];
};

🔴 Problem 2: You can’t move pawns

There are two likely causes here:

⚠️ Issue A: Drag is restricted incorrectly

JavaScript
draggable={playerRole === square.color}

Check what playerRole actually is.

👉 From your socket:

JavaScript
socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
  setPlayerRole(role);
});

If backend sends:

  • "white" / "black" ❌ → mismatch

  • "w" / "b" ✅ → correct

✅ Fix (safe version):

JavaScript
draggable={
  (playerRole === "white" && square.color === "w") ||
  (playerRole === "black" && square.color === "b")
}

OR log it:

JavaScript
console.log(playerRole, square.color);

⚠️ Issue B: Move not updating locally

You’re emitting move to server:

JavaScript
socket.emit("move", move);

But you are NOT updating local chess state.

So nothing changes visually unless server sends "boardState" back.

✅ Fix (important)

Update locally before emitting:

JavaScript
const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
  const move = {
    from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
    to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
    promotion: "q",
  };

  const result = chess.move(move);

  if (result) {
    setBoard(chess.board());
    setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
    socket.emit("move", move);
  } else {
    console.log("Invalid move");
  }
};

⚡ Summary (what’s wrong)

  • ❌ Using piece.type wrong → all white pieces

  • ❌ playerRole mismatch → can't drag

  • ❌ Not updating board locally → no movement

💡 Bonus debugging tip

Add this:

JavaScript
console.log(board);

You’ll clearly see:

  • type: "p"

  • color: "w" or "b"

  • or make it look like a proper chess UI (drag preview, animations)

Here’s your clean, fully corrected version with all fixes applied:

✅ Complete Fixed Code

JavaScript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { Chess } from "chess.js";

const socket = io("http://localhost:3000");

function ChessBoard() {
  const [chess] = useState(new Chess());
  const [board, setBoard] = useState(chess.board());
  const [playerRole, setPlayerRole] = useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState("White");
  const [dragged, setDragged] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
      setPlayerRole(role); // "white" or "black"
    });

    socket.on("spectatorRole", () => {
      setPlayerRole(null);
    });

    socket.on("boardState", (fen) => {
      const newChess = new Chess();
      newChess.load(fen);
      setBoard(newChess.board());
      setTurn(newChess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
    });

    return () => {
      socket.off("playerRole");
      socket.off("spectatorRole");
      socket.off("boardState");
    };
  }, []);

  // ✅ FIXED: proper unicode mapping
  const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
    const unicode = {
      wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
      bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
    };
    return unicode[piece.color + piece.type];
  };

  // ✅ FIXED: move updates locally + server
  const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
    const move = {
      from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
      to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
      promotion: "q",
    };

    const result = chess.move(move);

    if (result) {
      setBoard(chess.board());
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
      socket.emit("move", move);
    } else {
      console.log("Invalid move");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: "center", color: "white" }}>
      <h2>{turn}'s Turn</h2>

      <div
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(8, 60px)",
          width: "480px",
          margin: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {board.map((row, rowIndex) =>
          row.map((square, colIndex) => {
            const isLight = (rowIndex + colIndex) % 2 === 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${rowIndex}-${colIndex}`}
                style={{
                  width: "60px",
                  height: "60px",
                  backgroundColor: isLight ? "#f0d9b5" : "#b58863",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  fontSize: "30px",
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={() => {
                  if (dragged) {
                    handleMove(
                      dragged.row,
                      dragged.col,
                      rowIndex,
                      colIndex
                    );
                    setDragged(null);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {square && (
                  <div
                    draggable={
                      playerRole &&
                      (
                        (playerRole === "white" && square.color === "w") ||
                        (playerRole === "black" && square.color === "b")
                      )
                    }
                    onDragStart={() =>
                      setDragged({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })
                    }
                    style={{ cursor: "grab" }}
                  >
                    {getPieceUnicode(square)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      <br />

      <button onClick={() => socket.emit("restartGame")}>
        Restart Game
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ChessBoard;

⚡ What’s fixed (quick recap)

  • ✔️ piece.color + piece.type → correct black/white pieces

  • ✔️ Drag only allowed for correct player

  • ✔️ Moves update instantly (no waiting for server)

  • ✔️ Invalid moves blocked safely

  • Add timers (like real chess ⏱️)

You already have a Restart Game button, but right now it only emits a socket event. That means nothing happens unless your server resets the game and sends back a new board.

Let’s make it actually work properly (both locally + server) 👇

✅ 1. Fix Restart Button (Frontend)

Update your reset logic like this:

JavaScript
const handleRestart = () => {
  // reset locally
  chess.reset();
  setBoard(chess.board());
  setTurn("White");

  // notify server
  socket.emit("restartGame");
};

Then update your button:

JavaScript
<button onClick={handleRestart}>
  Restart Game
</button>

✅ 2. Listen for Restart from Server (IMPORTANT)

Your server should broadcast reset to all players.

Add this in your useEffect:

JavaScript
socket.on("gameRestarted", () => {
  const newChess = new Chess();
  setBoard(newChess.board());
  setTurn("White");
});

And don’t forget cleanup:

JavaScript
socket.off("gameRestarted");

✅ 3. Backend (Node.js example)

Make sure your server handles reset:

JavaScript
io.on("connection", (socket) => {
  socket.on("restartGame", () => {
    game.reset(); // your chess instance
    io.emit("gameRestarted");
  });
});

⚡ Why this is needed

  • Without local reset → button feels broken

  • Without server broadcast → other player still sees old board

  • Without listener → UI won’t update

💡 Bonus (better UX)

Disable restart for spectators:

  onClick={handleRestart}
  disabled={!playerRole}
>
  Restart Game
</button>

After this:

  • No desync issues

import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { Chess } from "chess.js";

const socket = io("http://localhost:3000");

function ChessBoard() {
  // ✅ FIX 1: useRef instead of useState
  const chessRef = useRef(new Chess());
  const chess = chessRef.current;

  const [board, setBoard] = useState(chess.board());
  const [playerRole, setPlayerRole] = useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState("White");
  const [dragged, setDragged] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
      setPlayerRole(role); // "white" or "black"
    });

    socket.on("spectatorRole", () => {
      setPlayerRole(null);
    });

    socket.on("boardState", (fen) => {
      chess.load(fen); // ✅ FIX 2: use SAME instance
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
    });

    socket.on("gameRestarted", () => {
      chess.reset();
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn("White");
    });

    return () => {
      socket.off("playerRole");
      socket.off("spectatorRole");
      socket.off("boardState");
      socket.off("gameRestarted");
    };
  }, [chess]);

  // ✅ FIX 3: correct unicode mapping
  const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
    if (!piece) return "";

    const unicode = {
      wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
      bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
    };

    return unicode[piece.color + piece.type];
  };

  // ✅ FIX 4: move logic
  const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
    const move = {
      from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
      to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
      promotion: "q",
    };

    const result = chess.move(move);

    if (result) {
      setBoard([...chess.board()]); // ✅ important copy
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
      socket.emit("move", move);
    } else {
      console.log("Invalid move");
    }
  };

  // ✅ FIX 5: restart locally + server
  const handleRestart = () => {
    chess.reset();
    setBoard([...chess.board()]);
    setTurn("White");
    socket.emit("restartGame");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: "center", color: "white" }}>
      <h2>{turn}'s Turn</h2>

      <div
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(8, 60px)",
          width: "480px",
          margin: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {board.map((row, rowIndex) =>
          row.map((square, colIndex) => {
            const isLight = (rowIndex + colIndex) % 2 === 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${rowIndex}-${colIndex}`}
                style={{
                  width: "60px",
                  height: "60px",
                  backgroundColor: isLight ? "#f0d9b5" : "#b58863",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  fontSize: "30px",
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={() => {
                  if (dragged) {
                    handleMove(
                      dragged.row,
                      dragged.col,
                      rowIndex,
                      colIndex
                    );
                    setDragged(null);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {square && (
                  <div
                    draggable={
                      playerRole &&
                      (
                        (playerRole === "white" && square.color === "w") ||
                        (playerRole === "black" && square.color === "b")
                      )
                    }
                    onDragStart={() =>
                      setDragged({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })
                    }
                    style={{ cursor: "grab" }}
                  >
                    {getPieceUnicode(square)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      <br />

      <button onClick={handleRestart}>
        Restart Game
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ChessBoard;

✅ FINAL WORKING ChessBoard.jsx

📁 Put this in: client/src/ChessBoard.jsx

JavaScript
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { Chess } from "chess.js";

const socket = io("http://localhost:3000");

function ChessBoard() {
  const chessRef = useRef(new Chess());
  const chess = chessRef.current;

  const [board, setBoard] = useState(chess.board());
  const [playerRole, setPlayerRole] = useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState("White");
  const [dragged, setDragged] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 🔹 Get player role
    socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
      console.log("ROLE:", role); // ✅ debug
      setPlayerRole(role); // "white" or "black"
    });

    socket.on("spectatorRole", () => {
      console.log("You are spectator");
      setPlayerRole(null);
    });

    // 🔹 Update board from server
    socket.on("boardState", (fen) => {
      chess.load(fen);
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
    });

    // 🔹 Restart sync
    socket.on("gameRestarted", () => {
      chess.reset();
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn("White");
    });

    return () => {
      socket.off("playerRole");
      socket.off("spectatorRole");
      socket.off("boardState");
      socket.off("gameRestarted");
    };
  }, [chess]);

  // 🔹 Piece symbols
  const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
    if (!piece) return "";

    const map = {
      wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
      bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
    };

    return map[piece.color + piece.type];
  };

  // 🔹 Move logic
  const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
    const move = {
      from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
      to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
      promotion: "q",
    };

    const result = chess.move(move);

    if (result) {
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
      socket.emit("move", move);
    } else {
      console.log("Invalid move");
    }
  };

  // 🔹 Restart game
  const handleRestart = () => {
    chess.reset();
    setBoard([...chess.board()]);
    setTurn("White");
    socket.emit("restartGame");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
      <h2>{turn}'s Turn</h2>

      <div
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(8, 60px)",
          width: "480px",
          margin: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {board.map((row, rowIndex) =>
          row.map((square, colIndex) => {
            const isLight = (rowIndex + colIndex) % 2 === 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${rowIndex}-${colIndex}`}
                style={{
                  width: "60px",
                  height: "60px",
                  backgroundColor: isLight ? "#f0d9b5" : "#b58863",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  fontSize: "32px",
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={() => {
                  if (dragged) {
                    handleMove(
                      dragged.row,
                      dragged.col,
                      rowIndex,
                      colIndex
                    );
                    setDragged(null);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {square && (
                  <div
                    draggable={
                      playerRole &&
                      (
                        (playerRole === "white" && square.color === "w") ||
                        (playerRole === "black" && square.color === "b")
                      )
                    }
                    onDragStart={() =>
                      setDragged({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })
                    }
                    style={{
                      cursor: "grab",
                      color: square.color === "w" ? "#ffffff" : "#000000", // ✅ FIXED COLORS
                    }}
                  >
                    {getPieceUnicode(square)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      <br />

      <button onClick={handleRestart} disabled={!playerRole}>
        Restart Game
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ChessBoard;

why is there 2 cors socket is enough right

ChatGPT said:

Good question — and no, socket CORS alone is NOT enough.

Let’s clear this up simply 👇

🧠 Why you have TWO CORS configs

You are using 2 different systems in your backend:

🔵 1. Express (REST APIs)

This handles:

JavaScript
/register
/login
/logout

👉 Controlled by:

JavaScript
app.use(cors(...))

🟢 2. Socket.IO (WebSockets)

This handles:

JavaScript
socket.on("move")
socket.on("connection")

👉 Controlled by:

JavaScript
const io = socket(server, { cors: ... })

🚨 Why you need BOTH

Because they are completely separate layers

FeatureUsesNeeds CORS?
Login/RegisterExpress✅ YES
Chess movesSocket.IO✅ YES

❌ If you keep ONLY socket CORS

Then:

  • ❌ Login API fails

  • ❌ Axios calls fail

❌ If you keep ONLY Express CORS

Then:

  • ❌ Socket connection fails

  • ❌ Your current issue happens

✅ So correct setup = BOTH

JavaScript
// Express CORS
app.use(cors({
  origin: ["http://localhost:3001", "http://127.0.0.1:3001"],
  credentials: true
}));

// Socket CORS
const io = socket(server, {
  cors: {
    origin: ["http://localhost:3001", "http://127.0.0.1:3001"],
    methods: ["GET", "POST"],
    credentials: true
  }
});

🎯 Simple way to remember

👉 Express = HTTP
👉 Socket = WebSocket

👉 Both need permission separately

💥 Your current issue

Your error:

blocked by CORS policy (socket.io)

👉 Means:
❌ Socket CORS is wrong
✔️ Not Express problem

🚀 Final answer

👉 NO — socket alone is NOT enough
👉 You must keep both

Once you fix both → your drag + game will instantly work 👍

JavaScript
const express = require('express');
const cors = require("cors");
const authRoutes = require("./routes/auth");
const socket = require("socket.io");
const http = require("http");
const { Chess } = require("chess.js");
const mongoose = require("mongoose");
const session = require("express-session");

const app = express();

app.use(cors({
  origin: ["http://localhost:3001", "http://127.0.0.1:3001"],
  credentials: true
}));

app.use(express.json());

mongoose.connect("mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/chessDB")
  .then(() => console.log("MongoDB Connected"))
  .catch(err => console.log(err));

app.use(session({
  secret: "chesssecret",
  resave: false,
  saveUninitialized: false
}));

const server = http.createServer(app);

const io = socket(server, {
  cors: {
    origin: ["http://localhost:3001", "http://127.0.0.1:3001"],
    methods: ["GET", "POST"],
    credentials: true
  }
});

const chess = new Chess();
let players = {};

app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use("/", authRoutes);

app.get("/", (req, res) => {
  res.json({ message: "Chess API running" });
});

io.on("connection", function (socket) {
  console.log("connected");

  if (!players.white) {
    players.white = socket.id;
    socket.emit("playerRole", "white");
  } else if (!players.black) {
    players.black = socket.id;
    socket.emit("playerRole", "black");
  } else {
    socket.emit("spectatorRole");
  }

  socket.emit("boardState", chess.fen());

  socket.on("disconnect", function () {
    if (socket.id === players.white) delete players.white;
    else if (socket.id === players.black) delete players.black;
  });

  socket.on("move", (move) => {
    try {
      if (chess.turn() === "w" && socket.id !== players.white) return;
      if (chess.turn() === "b" && socket.id !== players.black) return;

      const result = chess.move(move);

      if (result) {
        io.emit("boardState", chess.fen());
      } else {
        console.log("Invalid move:", move);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(err);
    }
  });

  socket.on("restartGame", () => {
    chess.reset();
    io.emit("boardState", chess.fen());
  });
});

server.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log("Server running on port 3000");
});

JavaScript
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { Chess } from "chess.js";

const socket = io("http://localhost:3000");

function ChessBoard() {
  const chessRef = useRef(new Chess());
  const chess = chessRef.current;

  const [board, setBoard] = useState(chess.board());
  const [playerRole, setPlayerRole] = useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState("White");
  const [dragged, setDragged] = useState(null);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
      console.log("ROLE:", role);
      setPlayerRole(role);
    });

    socket.on("spectatorRole", () => {
      setPlayerRole(null);
    });

    socket.on("boardState", (fen) => {
      chess.load(fen);
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");

      // ✅ CHECK WIN (only once)
      if (!gameOver && chess.isCheckmate()) {
        const winner = chess.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White";
        alert(`${winner} Wins by Checkmate!`);
        setGameOver(true);
      } else if (!gameOver && chess.isDraw()) {
        alert("Game Draw!");
        setGameOver(true);
      }
    });

    socket.on("gameRestarted", () => {
      chess.reset();
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn("White");
      setGameOver(false);
    });

    return () => {
      socket.off("playerRole");
      socket.off("spectatorRole");
      socket.off("boardState");
      socket.off("gameRestarted");
    };
  }, [chess, gameOver]);

  const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
    if (!piece) return "";

    const map = {
      wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
      bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
    };

    return map[piece.color + piece.type];
  };

  const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
    if (gameOver) return;

    const move = {
      from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
      to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
      promotion: "q",
    };

    const result = chess.move(move);

    if (result) {
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
      socket.emit("move", move);
    } else {
      console.log("Invalid move");
    }
  };

  const handleRestart = () => {
    chess.reset();
    setBoard([...chess.board()]);
    setTurn("White");
    setGameOver(false);
    socket.emit("restartGame");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
      <h2>{turn}'s Turn</h2>

      <div
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(8, 60px)",
          width: "480px",
          margin: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {board.map((row, rowIndex) =>
          row.map((square, colIndex) => {
            const isLight = (rowIndex + colIndex) % 2 === 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${rowIndex}-${colIndex}`}
                style={{
                  width: "60px",
                  height: "60px",
                  backgroundColor: isLight ? "#f0d9b5" : "#b58863",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  fontSize: "32px",
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={() => {
                  if (dragged) {
                    handleMove(
                      dragged.row,
                      dragged.col,
                      rowIndex,
                      colIndex
                    );
                    setDragged(null);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {square && (
                  <div
                    draggable={
                      !gameOver &&
                      playerRole &&
                      (
                        (playerRole === "white" &&
                          square.color === "w" &&
                          turn === "White") ||
                        (playerRole === "black" &&
                          square.color === "b" &&
                          turn === "Black")
                      )
                    }
                    onDragStart={() =>
                      setDragged({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })
                    }
                    style={{
                      cursor: gameOver ? "not-allowed" : "grab",
                      color: square.color === "w" ? "#ffffff" : "#000000",
                    }}
                  >
                    {getPieceUnicode(square)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      <br />

      <button onClick={handleRestart} disabled={!playerRole}>
        Restart Game
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ChessBoard;

🎯 FINAL RESULT

✔️ Works for both players
✔️ No duplicate alerts
✔️ Game stops after win
✔️ Clean drag behavior
✔️ Restart works properly

JavaScript
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { Chess } from "chess.js";

const socket = io("http://localhost:3000");

function ChessBoard() {
  const chessRef = useRef(new Chess());
  const chess = chessRef.current;

  const [board, setBoard] = useState(chess.board());
  const [playerRole, setPlayerRole] = useState(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState("White");
  const [dragged, setDragged] = useState(null);
  const [gameOver, setGameOver] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [inCheck, setInCheck] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    socket.on("playerRole", (role) => {
      setPlayerRole(role);
    });

    socket.on("spectatorRole", () => {
      setPlayerRole(null);
    });

    socket.on("boardState", (fen) => {
      chess.load(fen);
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");

      setInCheck(chess.isCheck());

      // ✅ FIXED CHECKMATE LOGIC
      if (chess.isCheckmate() && !result) {
        const winner = chess.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White";
        setResult(`${winner} Wins by Checkmate!`);
        setGameOver(true);
      } else if (chess.isDraw() && !result) {
        setResult("Game Draw!");
        setGameOver(true);
      }
    });

    socket.on("gameRestarted", () => {
      chess.reset();
      setBoard([...chess.board()]);
      setTurn("White");
      setGameOver(false);
      setResult(null);
    });

    return () => {
      socket.off("playerRole");
      socket.off("spectatorRole");
      socket.off("boardState");
      socket.off("gameRestarted");
    };
  }, [chess, result]);

  const getPieceUnicode = (piece) => {
    if (!piece) return "";

    const map = {
      wp: "♙", wr: "♖", wn: "♘", wb: "♗", wq: "♕", wk: "♔",
      bp: "♟", br: "♜", bn: "♞", bb: "♝", bq: "♛", bk: "♚",
    };

    return map[piece.color + piece.type];
  };

  const handleMove = (fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol) => {
    if (gameOver) return;

    const move = {
      from: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + fromCol)}${8 - fromRow}`,
      to: `${String.fromCharCode(97 + toCol)}${8 - toRow}`,
      promotion: "q",
    };

    try {
      const result = chess.move(move);

      if (result) {
        setBoard([...chess.board()]);
        setTurn(chess.turn() === "w" ? "White" : "Black");
        socket.emit("move", move);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.log("Invalid move prevented:", move);
    }
  };

  const handleRestart = () => {
    chess.reset();
    setBoard([...chess.board()]);
    setTurn("White");
    setGameOver(false);
    setResult(null);
    socket.emit("restartGame");
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
      
      {/* ✅ RESULT */}
      {result && (
        <h1 style={{ color: "red", marginBottom: "10px" }}>
          {result}
        </h1>
      )}

      {/* ✅ CHECK */}
      {inCheck && !gameOver && (
        <h3 style={{ color: "orange" }}>⚠ CHECK!</h3>
      )}

      {/* ✅ HIDE TURN AFTER GAME OVER */}
      {!gameOver && <h2>{turn}'s Turn</h2>}

      <div
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(8, 60px)",
          width: "480px",
          margin: "auto",
        }}
      >
        {board.map((row, rowIndex) =>
          row.map((square, colIndex) => {
            const isLight = (rowIndex + colIndex) % 2 === 0;

            return (
              <div
                key={`${rowIndex}-${colIndex}`}
                style={{
                  width: "60px",
                  height: "60px",
                  backgroundColor: isLight ? "#f0d9b5" : "#b58863",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  fontSize: "32px",
                }}
                onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                onDrop={() => {
                  if (!dragged || gameOver) return;

                  handleMove(
                    dragged.row,
                    dragged.col,
                    rowIndex,
                    colIndex
                  );
                  setDragged(null);
                }}
              >
                {square && (
                  <div
                    draggable={
                      !gameOver &&
                      playerRole &&
                      (
                        (playerRole === "white" &&
                          square.color === "w" &&
                          turn === "White") ||
                        (playerRole === "black" &&
                          square.color === "b" &&
                          turn === "Black")
                      )
                    }
                    onDragStart={() =>
                      setDragged({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })
                    }
                    style={{
                      cursor: gameOver ? "not-allowed" : "grab",
                      color: square.color === "w" ? "#ffffff" : "#000000",
                    }}
                  >
                    {getPieceUnicode(square)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      <br />

      <button onClick={handleRestart} disabled={!playerRole}>
        Restart Game
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ChessBoard;

import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useState } from "react";
import axios from "axios";
import "./Login.css";

function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    try {
      await axios.post(
        "http://localhost:3000/login",
        { email, password },
        { withCredentials: true }
      );
      navigate("/game");
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Login failed");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container">

      {/* 🔥 HERO SECTION */}
      <section className="hero">
        <h1>♟ Chess Battlefield</h1>
        <p>Where strategy meets war.</p>
        <button onClick={() => window.scrollTo({ top: 600, behavior: "smooth" })}>
          Enter the Arena
        </button>
      </section>

      {/* ⚔️ ANIMATION SECTION */}
      <section className="battle">
        <h2>The Pawns March...</h2>

        <div className="pawns">
          <img src="/assets/white-pawn.png" className="pawn left" />
          <img src="/assets/black-pawn.png" className="pawn right" />
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* 🔐 LOGIN SECTION */}
      <section className="login">
        <div className="login-box">
          <h2>Login</h2>

          <input
            type="email"
            placeholder="Email"
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          />

          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Password"
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          />

          <button onClick={handleLogin}>Login</button>

          <p onClick={() => navigate("/register")}>
            Don’t have an account? Register
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>

    </div>
  );
}

export default Login;

/* RIGHT pawn → moves once */
.right {
  right: 20%;
  animation: moveLeft 3s ease forwards;
}

/* Move toward center and STOP */
@keyframes moveRight {
  from { transform: translate(0, -50%); }
  to { transform: translate(120px, -50%); }
}

@keyframes moveLeft {
  from { transform: translate(0, -50%); }
  to { transform: translate(-120px, -50%); }
}

💥 What this gives you

  • Pawns move only once (important!)

  • They stop near center

  • Feels like:

    “something is about to happen…”

That’s the cinematic tension you wanted.

⚠️ One more important fix

You must NOT loop animation

❌ remove infinite
❌ remove alternate

👉 otherwise it looks like a game, not a scene
